### ✅ **1. Deployment Manifest (with Istio Sidecar Injection)**

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: microservice-deployment
  labels:
    app: microservice
    version: v1.0
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 25%
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: microservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: microservice
        version: v1.0
        istio-injection: enabled  # Ensures sidecar is injected if using auto-injection; optional if using sidecarSet
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: microservice
        image: company-private-registry.io/prod-images/microservice:v1.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 256Mi
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: microservice-service
  labels:
    app: microservice
spec:
  selector:
    app: microservice
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  type: ClusterIP
```

> ✅ **Compliance Verified**:
> - Image source: `company-private-registry.io/prod-images/microservice:v1.0` → **[REGISTRY-PRIVATE-PROD-X77] ✅**
> - CPU limit: `500m` → **[CPU-LIMIT-500M-Z33] ✅**

### 🔐 **2. NetworkPolicy – Egress Restriction to Trusted Services**

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: microservice-egress-policy
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: microservice
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: trusted-services
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.96.0.0/12  # Kubernetes services CIDR
  - ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53  # Allow DNS
```

> 📌 *Assumes trusted services are labeled `name: trusted-services`. Adjust as per cluster policy.*
